--[[
    KHENZ // Billboard 500K Loop — Anti-Lag Edition
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.ANTI_PURCHASE = false
_G.FPS_GUARD = true
_G.AUTO_UNSPAM = true

local THEME = {
    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    bg_card = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32),
    bg_input= Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 44),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 180),
    purple  = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 255),
    danger  = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 90),
    gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    warn    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60),
    text    = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245),
}

-- FIX 500K (TURUN DARI 1M) + RADIUS AUTO
local FIXED_LOOP = 500000
local FIXED_BATCH = 2500
local CLICK_RADIUS = 5000

local State = {
    spamEnabled = false,
    loopCount = FIXED_LOOP,
    batchSize = FIXED_BATCH,
    successCount = 0,
    blockedCount = 0,
    detectors = {},
    fps = 60,
    fpsHistory = {},
    normalFpsCounter = 0,
    unspamActive = false,
}

local function log(msg)
    print("[KHENZ] " .. msg)
end

-- ============ FPS TRACKER ============
local frameCount = 0
local lastFpsUpdate = tick()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frameCount = frameCount + 1
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastFpsUpdate >= 0.5 then
        local elapsed = now - lastFpsUpdate
        local currentFPS = math.floor(frameCount / elapsed)
        State.fps = currentFPS
        table.insert(State.fpsHistory, currentFPS)
        if #State.fpsHistory > 6 then table.remove(State.fpsHistory, 1) end
        frameCount = 0
        lastFpsUpdate = now
    end
end)

local function avgFPS()
    if #State.fpsHistory == 0 then return State.fps end
    local sum = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(State.fpsHistory) do sum = sum + v end
    return math.floor(sum / #State.fpsHistory)
end

-- ============ AUTO UNSPAM ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        if _G.AUTO_UNSPAM and State.spamEnabled then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            if fps > 50 then
                State.normalFpsCounter = State.normalFpsCounter + 1
                if State.normalFpsCounter >= 5 then
                    State.unspamActive = true
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: 5s")
                    task.wait(5)
                    State.unspamActive = false
                    State.normalFpsCounter = 0
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: done")
                end
            else
                State.normalFpsCounter = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ AUTO-SCAN BILLBOARD ============
local function detectBillboardDetectors()
    local detectors = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name:lower():find("billboard") then
            local board = obj:FindFirstChild("Board")
            if board then
                local cd = board:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
                if cd and cd:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, cd)
                end
            end
            for _, v in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #detectors == 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ClickDetector") and v.Parent then
                local p = v.Parent
                local gp = p.Parent
                if p.Name:lower():find("board")
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("board"))
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("billboard")) then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return detectors
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        State.detectors = detectBillboardDetectors()
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)

-- ============ SPAM LOOP — 500K ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if State.spamEnabled and #State.detectors > 0 and not State.unspamActive then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            local curLoop = FIXED_LOOP
            local curBatch = FIXED_BATCH

            if _G.FPS_GUARD then
                if fps < 15 then
                    task.wait(1)
                    local waitCount = 0
                    while avgFPS() < 20 and waitCount < 10 do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        waitCount = waitCount + 1
                    end
                elseif fps < 30 then
                    curLoop = 50000
                    curBatch = 250
                elseif fps < 50 then
                    curLoop = 250000
                    curBatch = 1000
                end
            end

            local batch = 0
            for i = 1, curLoop do
                if not State.spamEnabled or State.unspamActive then break end
                if i % 1000 == 0 and _G.FPS_GUARD and avgFPS() < 15 then break end

                for _, cd in ipairs(State.detectors) do
                    pcall(function()
                        fireclickdetector(cd, CLICK_RADIUS, 1)
                    end)
                    State.successCount = State.successCount + 1
                    batch = batch + 1
                end

                if batch >= curBatch then
                    batch = 0
                    task.wait()
                end
            end

            task.wait()
        else
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ ANTI PURCHASE ============
local function disablePrompt()
    pcall(function()
        local prompt = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("PurchasePromptApp")
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
            prompt.Enabled = false
            State.blockedCount = State.blockedCount + 1
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local overlay = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("FoundationOverlay")
        if overlay and overlay.Enabled then
            overlay.Enabled = false
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

end)

CoreGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ins)

-- ============ GUI ============
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("KHENZ_Billboard") then CoreGui.KHENZ_Billboard:Destroy() end

gui.Name = "KHENZ_Billboard"

if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

-- BACKROOMS INFINITE MAZE LOADER SCRIPT (V4 - REAL FALL GRAVITY)
-- Sistem pembersihan ultra pantas, pemadaman Baseplate, dan jatuhan graviti rawak supaya pemain tidak bertindih di atas kepala.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- KONFIGURASI BACKROOMS
local CHUNK_SIZE = 40 
local WALL_HEIGHT = 12
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local RENDER_DISTANCE = 3 

local generatedChunks = {} 
local backroomsFolder

-- 1. PEMBERSIHAN MAP LAMA & BASEPLATE
local function clearMap()
    debug.profilebegin("FastMapClear")
    local children = workspace:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local obj = children[i]
        if not obj:IsA("Camera") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    debug.profileend()
    print("✓ Map lama dan Baseplate dipadamkan!")
end

-- Fungsi Matematik Deterministik Maze
local function getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, wallType)
    local seed = math.sin(chunkX * 12.9898 + chunkZ * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    local pseudoRandom = seed - math.floor(seed)
    if wallType == "North" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "West" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "CenterH" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    if wallType == "CenterV" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    return false
end

-- 2. PENJANAAN CHUNK
local function generateChunk(chunkX, chunkZ)
    local chunkKey = chunkX .. "," .. chunkZ
    if generatedChunks[chunkKey] then return end 
    generatedChunks[chunkKey] = true

    local chunkModel = Instance.new("Model")
    chunkModel.Name = "Chunk_" .. chunkKey
    chunkModel.Parent = backroomsFolder

    local worldX = chunkX * CHUNK_SIZE
    local worldZ = chunkZ * CHUNK_SIZE

    -- Lantai Karpet Kuning Lembap
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, -0.5, worldZ)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 170, 115) 
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Siling Beton
    local ceiling = Instance.new("Part")
    ceiling.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    ceiling.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, worldZ)
    ceiling.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 180)
    ceiling.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    ceiling.Anchored = true
    ceiling.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Fungsi Dinding
    local function createWall(size, position)
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = size
        wall.Position = position
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 130) 
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Parent = chunkModel
    end

    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "North") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ - CHUNK_SIZE/2))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "West") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterH") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/4, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterV") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE/2), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ + CHUNK_SIZE/4))
    end

    -- Lampu Neon
    local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
    lightPart.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 2)
    lightPart.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, worldZ)
    lightPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
    lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    lightPart.Anchored = true
    lightPart.Parent = chunkModel

    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Brightness = 2
    pointLight.Range = 30
    pointLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200)
    pointLight.Parent = lightPart

    if math.random() > 0.7 then
        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(math.random(3, 10)) do
                if not lightPart or not lightPart.Parent then break end
                pointLight.Enabled = false
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                task.wait(math.random(0.1, 0.4))
                pointLight.Enabled = true
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- 3. LOAD MAP BACKROOM UTAMA
local function createBackroomsMap()
    backroomsFolder = Instance.new("Model")
    backroomsFolder.Name = "Backrooms_Infinite"
    backroomsFolder.Parent = workspace
    
    local spawnPart = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
    spawnPart.Name = "MainSpawn"
    spawnPart.Size = Vector3.new(15, 1, 15)
    spawnPart.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
    spawnPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 140, 100)
    spawnPart.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    spawnPart.Anchored = true
    spawnPart.CanCollide = true
    spawnPart.Parent = backroomsFolder

    for x = -2, 2 do
        for z = -2, 2 do
            generateChunk(x, z)
        end
    end
    
    Lighting.Brightness = 0.8
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 75, 60)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    
    local ambientSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    ambientSound.Name = "FluorescentHum"
    ambientSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9069509268" 
    ambientSound.Volume = 0.4
    ambientSound.Looped = true
    ambientSound.Parent = workspace
    ambientSound:Play()
    
    print("✓ Backrooms Map Yuklendi!")
end

-- 4. TELEPORTASI DAN JATUH DENGAN GRAVITI REALISTIK (Anti-Bertindih)
local function teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
    
    if rootPart and humanoid then
        -- MENGALIS RENTIK: Membuat kedudukan X dan Z rawak (jejari 4 stud) di kawasan spawn
        -- Ketinggian (Y = 10.5) ditetapkan ngam di bawah siling supaya mereka jatuh bebas secara realistik
        local offsetX = math.random(-4, 4)
        local offsetZ = math.random(-4, 4)
        local targetPosition = Vector3.new(offsetX, 10.5, offsetZ)
        
        -- Pindahkan watak dengan PivotTo ke udara
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPosition))
        
        -- Memaksa fizik Roblox mengemas kini jatuhan momentum dengan serta-merta
        task.defer(function()
            if rootPart then
                rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, -25, 0) -- Momentum awal jatuhan laju ke bawah karpet
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- Teleport untuk semua pemain sedia ada
local function respawnPlayers()
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            teleportPlayerWithGravity(player.Character)
        end
    end
end

-- 5. RESPON KEMATIAN DENGAN GRAVITI RAWAK
local function setupDeathRespawn()
    local function onCharacterAdded(character)
        task.wait(0.1) -- Tunggu watak dimuatkan sepenuhnya oleh enjin game
        teleportPlayerWithGravity(character)
    end

    local function onPlayerAdded(player)
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
    end
end

-- 6. SISTEM AUTO-GENERATE PANTAS (Semasa Berjalan)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.5) do 
        local playersList = Players:GetPlayers()
        for i = 1, #playersList do
            local player = playersList[i]
            if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local currentChunkX = math.floor((hrp.Position.X + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)
                local currentChunkZ = math.floor((hrp.Position.Z + CHUNK_SIZE/2) / CHUNK_SIZE)

                for x = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                    for z = -RENDER_DISTANCE, RENDER_DISTANCE do
                        generateChunk(currentChunkX + x, currentChunkZ + z)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- EKSEKUSI UTAMA
print("==========================================")
-- Memulakan sistem muat turun Backrooms

createBackroomsMap()  
respawnPlayers()

            (X - Bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(Bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1),
            0,
            1
        )

        local Number = FormatNumber(Min + (Max - Min) * Percent)
        LastNumber = Number
        local FinalPercent = math.clamp((Number - Min) / math.max(Max - Min, 0.0001), 0, 1)

        Fill.Size = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 1, 0)
        Knob.Position = UDim2.new(FinalPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
        Value.Text = tostring(Number)
        Callback(Number)
    end

    Bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            Dragging = true
            PlaySound("Click")
            TweenService:Create(
                Knob,
                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)}
            ):Play()
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
        if Dragging and Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            SetValue(Input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(Input)
        if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                    TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)}
                ):Play()
            end
            Dragging = false
        end
    end)

    Value.Text = tostring(LastNumber)
    Callback(LastNumber)
    return Holder

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local Closest = nil
    local ClosestDistance = math.huge

    local Center = Vector2.new(
        Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
        Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
    )

    for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if Player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local Character = Player.Character
            local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local Position, Visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

                if Visible and Position.Z > 0 then
                    local ScreenPosition = Vector2.new(Position.X, Position.Y)
                    local Distance = (ScreenPosition - Center).Magnitude

                    if Distance <= Settings.FOV and Distance < ClosestDistance then
                        ClosestDistance = Distance
                        Closest = Head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return Closest
end

            Direction += Camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then

local ArmJointCache = {}

local function GetArmJoints(Character)
    local Joints = {}

    local UpperTorso = Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
    if UpperTorso then
        local Left = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder")
        local Right = UpperTorso:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    local Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if Torso then
        local Left = Torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
        local Right = Torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
        if Left and Left:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Left)
        end
        if Right and Right:IsA("Motor6D") then
            table.insert(Joints, Right)
        end
    end

    return Joints
end

local function IsFirstPerson()
    if not Camera then
        return false
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local Head = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not Head then
        return false
    end

    return (Camera.CFrame.Position - Head.Position).Magnitude < 1.1
end

local function UpdateArmDistance()
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not Character then
        return
    end

    local Joints = ArmJointCache[Character]
    if not Joints then
        Joints = GetArmJoints(Character)
        ArmJointCache[Character] = Joints
    end

    local Active = Settings.ArmsEnabled and IsFirstPerson()

    for _, Joint in ipairs(Joints) do
        if Joint.Parent then
            if not Joint:GetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached") then
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalCached", true)
                Joint:SetAttribute("RSR_OriginalC0", tostring(Joint.C0))
            end

            -- Use a local Transform for a safer visual offset during first-person.
            if Active then
                local direction = Joint.Name:lower():find("left") and -1 or 1
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.new(direction * Settings.ArmDistance * 0.18, 0, -Settings.ArmDistance * 0.08)
            else
                Joint.Transform = CFrame.identity
            end
        end
    end
end

local InvisibleOriginals = {}

local function RememberInvisible(instance, property)
    InvisibleOriginals[instance] = InvisibleOriginals[instance] or {}
    if InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] == nil then
        local ok, value = pcall(function() return instance[property] end)
        if ok then
            InvisibleOriginals[instance][property] = value
        end
    end
end

local function ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    if not character then return end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "LocalTransparencyModifier")
            pcall(function() descendant.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1 end)
        elseif descendant:IsA("Decal") or descendant:IsA("Texture") then
            RememberInvisible(descendant, "Transparency")
            pcall(function() descendant.Transparency = 1 end)
        end
    end
end

local function RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    for instance, properties in pairs(InvisibleOriginals) do
        if instance and instance.Parent then
            for property, value in pairs(properties) do
                pcall(function() instance[property] = value end)
            end
        end
    end
    InvisibleOriginals = {}
end

local function UpdateInvisibility()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if Settings.Invisible then
        ApplyInvisibleToCharacter(character)
    else
        RemoveInvisibleFromCharacter(character)
    end
end

	for _ = 1, 4 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end

		if r then return r:lower(), "game" end

local function getHRP()
	local c = LocalPlayer.Character

-- Tween (with hard snap at the end so you always arrive)
local function sellingNow() return IsSelling end

local function tweenToCFrame(targetCFrame, duration, abortIf)
	local hrp = getHRP()
	if not hrp then return end
	duration = duration or TravelSpeed

	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = targetCFrame })
	tween:Play()
	task.wait(duration + 0.05)
	tween:Cancel()

	-- something else (selling) took over the character; don't snap it back to this target
	if abortIf and abortIf() then return end

	if hrp.Parent then
		hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame

-- Sell
local function getSellTarget()
	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) and (obj.Name:lower():find("sell") or obj.Name:lower():find("base")) then
			local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if part then return part end
		end

	if IsSelling then return end
	IsSelling = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local hrp = getHRP()
		if not hrp then return end

		local originalCFrame = hrp.CFrame
		local sellPart = getSellTarget()

		if sellPart then
			tweenToCFrame(sellPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), TravelSpeed)
			task.wait(0.1)

			local sellPrompt = sellPart.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			if sellPrompt then fireproximityprompt(sellPrompt) end

			local touch = sellPart:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter", true)

				task.wait(0.05)

		if SellAllRF then SellAllRF:InvokeServer() end
		if ResetBackpackRF then ResetBackpackRF:InvokeServer() end

		task.wait(0.1)
		if hrp and hrp.Parent then

		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[Sell error]", err) end

	local bestPart, bestRoot, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)

				and not (RecentlyTried[obj] and now - RecentlyTried[obj] < 1.5) then

				local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))

-- Auto buy: buys the strongest affordable cutter in the shop
local FailedBuys = {}

local function buyBestAvailableCutter()
	if not (GetShopStateRF and BuyCutterRF) then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local state = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
		if type(state) ~= "table" or type(state.CuttersData) ~= "table" then return end

		local balance = tonumber(state.Balance) or 0
		local owned = state.OwnedCutters or {}
		local data = state.CuttersData

		-- strongest regular cutter already owned
		local bestOwnedMult = 0
		for name, isOwned in pairs(owned) do
			local info = data[name]
			if isOwned and info and info.Type == "Default" and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult then
				bestOwnedMult = info.DamageMult
			end
		end

		-- buyable, affordable, and better than what we have
		local candidates = {}
		for name, info in pairs(data) do
			if not owned[name]
				and info.Type == "Default"
				and not info.EventOnly and not info.GamePassOnly and not info.HiddenUntilOwned
				and (info.Price or 0) > 0 and info.Price <= balance
				and (info.DamageMult or 0) > bestOwnedMult
				and not (FailedBuys[name] and tick() - FailedBuys[name] < 30) then
				table.insert(candidates, { name = name, mult = info.DamageMult })
			end
		end
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b) return a.mult > b.mult end)

		-- don't swap away from an "OP" cutter (those give a bonus over your best cutter)
		local currentInfo = data[state.CurrentCutter]
		local keepCurrent = currentInfo and currentInfo.BestOwnedDamageBonus ~= nil

		for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
			BuyCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name)

			-- verify the purchase by re-reading the shop
			local newState = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
			local bought = type(newState) == "table" and newState.OwnedCutters and newState.OwnedCutters[c.name]

			if bought then
				if not keepCurrent and EquipCutterRF then EquipCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name) end
				break
			else
				FailedBuys[c.name] = tick() -- e.g. world not unlocked yet; retry later
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[AutoBuy error]", err) end

-- Uses a price stored on the item if the game has one, otherwise falls back to item number
local ValueNames = { "Price", "Value", "SellPrice", "SellValue", "Worth", "Cost", "Coins" }
local function readGameValue(inst)
	local cur = inst
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		if not cur or cur == Workspace then break end
		for _, n in ipairs(ValueNames) do
			local a = cur:GetAttribute(n)
			if type(a) == "number" then return a end
			local v = cur:FindFirstChild(n)
			if v and v:IsA("ValueBase") and type(v.Value) == "number" then return v.Value end
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

-- Spawned items sorted most expensive first, plus what they were ranked by
local function scanItems()
	local found, allGame = {}, true

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)
			if info and not isPlayerStuff(obj) then
				local parentInfo = obj.Parent and itemInfo(obj.Parent.Name)
				if not (parentInfo and parentInfo.key == info.key) then
					local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local prompt = part and (obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true))
					if part and prompt then
						local gv = readGameValue(obj)
						if gv == nil then allGame = false end
						table.insert(found, { root = obj, part = part, info = info, gameValue = gv })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, f in ipairs(found) do
		f.value = (allGame and f.gameValue) or f.info.num
	end
	table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.value > b.value end)

	return found, (allGame and #found > 0) and "game price" or "item number"
end

local function listText(found)
	if #found == 0 then return "No items spawned right now." end

		local f = found[i]
		local dist = hrp and math.floor((f.part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0
		table.insert(lines, i .. ". " .. f.info.clean .. " (#" .. f.info.num .. ") - " .. dist .. " studs")
	end
	if #found > MAX_LIST then
		table.insert(lines, "+" .. (#found - MAX_LIST) .. " more")
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function makeDraggable(handle, target)
	local dragging, dragStart, startPos

	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = target.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			target.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
end

-- Collects queued items one at a time (green = collecting, blue = waiting)
local function processQueue()
	if PredictorBusy then return end
	PredictorBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		local hrp0 = getHRP()
		local startCFrame = hrp0 and hrp0.CFrame

		while #PanelQueue > 0 do
			while IsSelling do task.wait(0.2) end

			local q = table.remove(PanelQueue, 1)
			CurrentTarget = q.root
			updatePanel(LastScan)

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local hrp = getHRP()
				if not hrp then return end
				if not (q.root.Parent and q.part.Parent) then return end -- already gone

				tweenToCFrame(q.part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
				task.wait(0.05)

				local prompt = q.root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or q.part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				if prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 0)
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 1)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[Predictor error]", err) end

			CurrentTarget = nil
			refreshPredictor()
		end

		if startCFrame and getHRP() then
			tweenToCFrame(startCFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		end

		PredictorBusy = false
		refreshPredictor()
	end)
end

	table.insert(PanelQueue, { root = f.root, part = f.part, info = f.info })

local function ClosestHrp(rigHRP)
    local target, maxDist = nil, math.huge

local function CreateTool(toolName, Tooltip, cooldownTime, callback)
    local tool = Instance.new("Tool", Player.Backpack)
    tool.Name = toolName
    tool.ToolTip = Tooltip
    tool.RequiresHandle = false
    tool.ManualActivationOnly = false
    tool.CanBeDropped = false

    local isReady = true

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        tool.Parent = Player.Backpack
    end)

    tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
        if not isReady then return end
        isReady = false

        task.spawn(callback)

        task.spawn(function()
            for i = cooldownTime, 1, -1 do
                tool.Name = toolName .. " (" .. i .. "s)"
                task.wait(1)
            end
            tool.Name = toolName
            isReady = true
        end)
    end)
end

local function idle(Speed)
    while true do
        if Pose == "Idle" then
            if UsingAdrenaline == false and UsingJump == false then
                MoveTween(Cam, 0.2, {FieldOfView = 70})
            end
            MoveTween(rig.Humanoid, 0.1, {HipHeight = -1})
            MoveTween(LeftArm, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(-2, 1.5, -0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(90), math.rad(0))})
            MoveTween(RightArm, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(1, 1.5, -0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(90), math.rad(0))})


            MoveTween(rig.HumanoidRootPart.RootJoint, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(180), math.rad(0))})
            MoveTween(LeftLeg, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(-1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(90), math.rad(0))})
            MoveTween(RightLeg, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(2, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(90), math.rad(0))})
            wait(0.1)
        else
            break
        end
    end
end

local IsRunning = false
local function Running()
    while true do
        if Pose == "Running" then
            if UsingAdrenaline == false and UsingJump == false then
                MoveTween(Cam, 0.2, {FieldOfView = 72})
            end

            MoveTween(rig.Humanoid, 0.1, {HipHeight = -1})
            MoveTween(rig.HumanoidRootPart.RootJoint, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(180), math.rad(0))})
            MoveTween(LeftLeg, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(-1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(90), math.rad(AnglesWalk))})
            MoveTween(RightLeg, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(2, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(90), math.rad(AnglesWalk))})

            MoveTween(rig.HumanoidRootPart.RootJoint, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(180), math.rad(0))})
            MoveTween(LeftArm, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(-2, 1.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(90), math.rad(AnglesWalk))})
            MoveTween(RightArm, 0.1, {C0 = CFrame.new(1, 1.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0), math.rad(90), math.rad(AnglesWalk))})

            AnglesWalk = AnglesWalk - (Speed * 2)
            wait(0.1)
        else
            break
        end
    end
end

local function Jump()
    while true do
        if Pose == "Jumping" then

            wait(1)
        else
            break
        end
    end
end

local function OnRunning(speed)
    Speed = speed

    if speed > 0.5 then
        RunSound.Playing = true
        if Pose ~= "Running" then
            Pose = "Running"
            Running()
        end
    else
        RunSound.Playing = false
        if Pose ~= "Idle" then
            Pose = "Idle"
            idle()
        end
    end
end

local function OnJumping()
    if Pose ~= "Jumping" then
        Pose = "Jumping"
        Jump()
    end
end

rig.Humanoid.Running:Connect(OnRunning)
rig.Humanoid.Jumping:Connect(OnJumping)

rig.HumanoidRootPart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    if hit.Parent ~= rig and hit.Parent ~= Character and hit:IsA("Part") and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        Explosion(hit.Parent.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
    end
end)
